description: EAGER: SSDIM: Data Generation for the Coupled System Composed of the Beef Cattle Production Infrastructure and the Transportation Services Infrastructure in Southwestern Kansas is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Caterina Scoglio, Kansas State University (k-state.edu). The overall objective of this project is to generate simulated data through modeling the behaviors of the interdependent beef production system and transportation infrastructure in southwestern Kansas, with due consideration of key social and economic factors. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-3ft2-0441. Keywords: Beef cattle production, Transportation, Synthetic Data, Interdependent systems. Published 2019-06-25. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
